title: Easterlies to affect N. Luzon; localized thunderstorms to prevail over PH

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The easterlies, or warm winds coming from the Pacific Ocean, may bring gloomy skies and occasional rains over Northern Luzon, while the rest of the country may experience localized thunderstorms on Tuesday, Sept. 15, the state weather bureau reported. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported in its 5 a.m. weather advisory that partly gloomy skies with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms may prevail over Batanes and Babuyan Islands due to the easterlies.
